short_description: Stream curated public domain animation shorts from the golden age.
full_description:

Features:
- Curated Library: Discover treasures from animation giants including Popeye, Betty Boop, Superman, and more.
- Intuitive Interface: Beautiful, Material 3 design optimized for mobile and TV.
- Watchlist & History: Bookmark your favorites and resume playback right where you left off.
- Ad-Free Experience: Enjoy an immersive experience focused solely on classic animation.
- Offline-Ready Data: Your watch progress is securely synced locally.

Browse by series, character, or category to find your next classic short. Whether you love slapstick comedy, black-and-white noir, or vintage serials, RetroToon TV is your window back to the golden era of animation.
